description: Counts the reactions most often reported to the FDA for a veterinary medicine active ingredient, optionally in one species, for example carprofen in dogs, most frequent first. Answers pet owners' and vets' questions about what has been reported with flea, worming, pain and allergy medicines. Source: FDA Center for Veterinary Medicine adverse event reports via openFDA. Counts are reports, not confirmed side effects or rates; search by active ingredient (e.g. "Oclacitinib" rather than a brand name), and it covers US reports only. (cost: 1 credit)

limit.description: integer, optional, 1-50, number of reactions to return, default 20

species.description: string, optional, animal species as reported, e.g. "Dog", "Cat", "Horse"; default all species

name: fda_pet_drug_reactions
